Home » AAPL slides into correction territory after mixed earnings results as the rest of market dips AAPL slides into correction territory after mixed earnings results as the rest of market dips 2 February 2018 Anon 
AAPL stock today has dipped into what some are calling a correction as the rest of the market is down in what may be the biggest stock selloff since 2016. Keep up to date with LMR Apple Support
